record.issue_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8 — CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is fetched without scheme/host validation, allowing plaintext http or internal-host token exfiltration if misconfigured

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the code does `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` with no validation/allowlist of scheme/host, so an operator could configure a plaintext `http://` URL or an internal URL and Cal.com would POST to it. That is a concrete hardening/config-safety concern introduced by the diff. However, the finding’s claimed impact of “token exfiltration” is not directly shown here because the request body only includes `calcomUserId` and `appSlug` (no refresh/access tokens are sent).
